dedupe_keys.name: tesfatsion open source software for the electric power industry catalogue of market simulators power flow and co simulation tools

description: This catalogue lists open source software for electricity market research, teaching and training, maintained by Leigh Tesfatsion of Iowa State University and last updated on 21 April 2026. It groups links by purpose: electricity market simulation (for example the AMES wholesale power market test bed, AMIRIS, FESTIV, MASCEM, PowerACE and the ERCOT and ISO-NE test systems), power flow and optimal power flow tools (ANDES, MATPOWER, PowerModels.jl, PSAT, pandapower, OpenDSS) and co-simulation, storage and PV tools such as ELICS, StorageVET and pvlib, with pages on evaluation of open source software for electricity markets and general reference materials. Access: free web page of links, and every listed tool keeps its own licence; the page says software is unsupported and provided as-is. Coverage is global and generic. Caveats: it is a curated list of one researcher, not a systematic registry, and link rot is possible; only the catalogue page was read here. It suits network flow and capacity planning studies that need a start point for finding open grid and market simulators, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
